name: Snapzy
title: Snapzy: free CleanShot X alternative
hook: CleanShot X charges you thirty five bucks to take and mark up screenshots. This app does it for free.

features.intro: It lives in your menu bar.
features.say: Grab an area, a window, a scrolling page, even text you can copy.
Then mark it up with arrows and text, and blur anything private.
It records video or GIFs too.

caption:
CleanShot X charges $35. Snapzy takes and marks up your screenshots for free 📸

✅ Area, window, scrolling and fullscreen screenshots
✅ Copy text straight out of any image
✅ Arrows, text and blur to mark it up
✅ Records video or GIFs too, 100% free

💻 Mac
ℹ️ Needs macOS 13 or later

Comment "SHOT" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day

#opensource #github #macos #macbook #screenshot #productivity #freeapps #techtips
dm_pitch: Snapzy, the free open-source CleanShot X alternative 📸
